mcp:tool-listener.doc:name: MCP Server - Tool Listener - Churn Score
mcp:tool-listener.name: get-customer-by-churn-score
mcp:tool-listener.mcp:description: return the details of custumer accourding to churn score asked.

logger.doc:name: Log - Request Received
logger.message: #["[get-customer-by-churn-score-flow] Tool invoked - score: " ++ (payload.score as String default "null")]

salesforce:query.salesforce:salesforce-query: SELECT Id, Name, AccountNumber, Email__c, Joined_on__c, tenure_year__c, Valid_Till__c, Last_Billing_Date__c, Total_Revenue__c, Autopay_Enabled__c, Contact_Preferances__c, Churn_Score__c, Churn_Risk_Level__c FROM Account WHERE AccountNumber LIKE 'ACC%' AND Churn_Score__c >= :score ORDER BY Churn_Score__c DESC

logger.doc:name: Log - Query Result
logger.message: #["[get-customer-by-churn-score-flow] Salesforce query returned " ++ (sizeOf(payload) as String) ++ " records"]
